elements.label: per-pixel thermopile empty-room baseline
elements.quote: The Stillroom S1 ceiling unit holds an 8 x 8 thermopile array (64 pixels) and a PIR (passive infrared) motion sensor, and reads the room's door contact over the local radio link.

elements.label: baseline update only after a PIR quiet window
elements.quote: Treat the room as verified empty only when the PIR has seen no motion for 20 minutes and the door contact reports closed.

elements.label: baseline update also gated on the door contact reporting closed
elements.quote: Treat the room as verified empty only when the PIR has seen no motion for 20 minutes and the door contact reports closed.

elements.label: slow EMA update with per-pixel freeze after detection
elements.quote: Freeze learning in any pixel where a person was detected in the last 10 minutes, so a still person is never absorbed into the background.

elements.label: per-pixel threshold from that pixel's noise
elements.quote: Set each pixel's detection threshold to baseline + 4 x that pixel's standard deviation.

implementation.quote: Firmware build fw-0.9.3 runs the gated update on the four test units in the 3rd-floor meeting room. Bench log reference BL-2026-011.

mechanism.quote: During a verified-empty window, record each pixel's mean temperature and its standard deviation over the window.

mechanism.quote: Update the baseline slowly: new baseline = 0.99 x old baseline + 0.01 x window mean, once per minute.

problem.quote: The thermal baseline drifts when HVAC (heating, ventilation and air conditioning) cycles, causing false "occupied" readings in empty rooms. Sun on the floor in the afternoon does the same.
